grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login or existing Universal Credit account
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and link the carer's element to your Universal Credit claim

grants.description: Check the benefit status of the person you care for
grants.purpose: To verify that the person you care for receives a qualifying disability benefit at the required rate

grants.description: Provide details about your caring responsibilities
grants.purpose: To assess your eligibility for the carer's element and calculate the correct payment

grants.description: Access your Universal Credit payment details to add the carer's element
grants.purpose: To determine if you're eligible for the carer's element and to calculate the revised Universal Credit payment including the carer's element

grants.description: Acknowledge that the person you care for may lose their severe disability premium
grants.purpose: To ensure you understand the potential impact on the care recipient's benefits before proceeding with the claim

revocation.mechanism: Report change of circumstances through your Universal Credit account, call the UC helpline, or speak to your work coach
revocation.effect: The carer's element will be removed from your Universal Credit payment. You may need to repay any overpayment if you continued to receive the element after your caring responsibilities ended.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot: provide false information about care hours or care recipient details; acknowledge severe disability premium impact on your behalf without your explicit confirmation; consent to verification checks with the care recipient; change the care recipient's benefits or contact them directly. Agent must hand off to human if: safeguarding concerns are identified; care arrangement appears to be commercial/paid employment; multiple conflicting carer claims exist for same care recipient.
